metadata.title: Formation of dwarf galaxies and small-scale problems of CDM

notes: Strict eligibility note: T:p3-b1 and T:p3-b5 name and model HVS1 and HVS2, while T:p3-b3 reports their high radial velocities and Galactic-center ejection and T:p3-b4 says an HVS trajectory is expected to be nearly a straight line. The supplied paper never explicitly states that HVS1 or HVS2 is unbound from the Milky Way or that either satisfies an escape-velocity criterion; its HVS label, proposed Galactic-center origin, and ejection mechanism are therefore insufficient. The "first three", "other four", and five-HVS HST samples (T:p3-b3; T:p4-b1) are not individually identified.
